name: Precision Digital Electronic Vernier Caliper with Large LCD (150mm / 6-Inch)
shortDescription: Hardened stainless steel 150mm (6-inch) digital vernier caliper with 0.01mm resolution, instant mm/inch conversion, large LCD screen, and 4-way measurement.
overview: This Precision Digital Electronic Vernier Caliper is a high-accuracy dimensional metrology tool designed for toolmakers, CNC machinists, quality assurance inspectors, and mechanical fitters. Constructed from fully hardened, finely ground stainless steel with a silky smooth slider action, it provides instantaneous digital readings with a high resolution of 0.01mm (0.0005 inches) across a 0 to 150mm measuring span. The extra-large high-contrast LCD screen eliminates parallax reading errors, while a one-touch toggle button switches between metric and imperial units.
keyFeatures: Hardened stainless steel main beam and measuring jaws ground to high metrology tolerances
High resolution of 0.01 mm / 0.0005 inch with high accuracy of ±0.02 mm (±0.001")
Extra-large high-contrast digital LCD screen allows effortless, error-free reading
One-touch instant toggle between Metric (mm) and Imperial (Inch) measurement modes
Zero button allows setting a temporary datum at any position for differential measurement
4-Way measuring capability: Outside diameter, Inside diameter, Depth rod, and Step measurement
Smooth knurled thumb roller and locking thumbscrew for precise micro-adjustments

specifications.Power Source: 1x 1.5V LR44 / SR44 Silver Oxide Button Cell

applications: CNC lathe turned parts inspection, shaft diameters, and bore depths
Quality control verification of stampings, castings, and mold cavities
Toolroom die making, jig calibration, and reverse engineering layout
Automotive engine rebuilds, piston clearance, and valve guide checking
